note: mp1_samplerate_table[], mp2_samplerate_table[] and mp25_samplerate_table[] are each declared with exactly 3 elements (one per MPEG version's sample rates). samplerate_idx is a 2-bit field extracted from flags (range 0-3; value 3 is the MPEG 'reserved' samplerate code) and flags is built directly from four fgetc() reads of the untrusted MP3 frame header, used to index whichever table matches the frame's MPEG version.

traces.message: flags built from fgetc(f) reads of the untrusted MP3 frame header
mp1_samplerate_table[samplerate_idx] -- 3-element array indexed by a 0-3 value, MPEG version 1
flags built from fgetc(f) reads of the untrusted MP3 frame header
mp2_samplerate_table[samplerate_idx] -- 3-element array indexed by a 0-3 value, MPEG version 2
flags built from fgetc(f) reads of the untrusted MP3 frame header
mp25_samplerate_table[samplerate_idx] -- 3-element array indexed by a 0-3 value, MPEG version 2.5
